name: ansible-security-scanner
description: 🛡️ Static security scanner (SAST) for Ansible playbooks, roles, and collections. 1,000+ rules across 30+ categories detecting malicious code, RCE, hardcoded credentials, and supply-chain risk. Outputs SARIF, CycloneDX SBOM, and GitLab SAST. SLSA Build Level 3, Sigstore-signed.

paragraphs: Static SAST scanner for Ansible playbooks, roles, collections, task files, vars, and inventories. Detects malicious code, RCE, command and template injection, hardcoded credentials, supply-chain risk, unauthorized cloud access, lateral movement, and reverse shells. Outputs SARIF, CycloneDX SBOM, GitLab SAST, JUnit, JSON, HTML, and Markdown reports with remediation guidance. Findings map to CWE, OWASP Top 10, OWASP ASVS, MITRE ATT&CK, NIST, and CIS. CI-native, autofix-capable, DevSecOps-ready.
1165 rules across 31 categories -- all auto-discovered from YAML pattern plugins.
460 critical, 551 high, 134 medium, 19 low. Per-category breakdown on the dashboard.
